metadata.question: Did the urban area in Mekele, Ethiopia, increase between 1984 and 2025?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Location: Mekele, Ethiopia (approximately 13.5°N, 39.5°E) - Date ranges: 1984 (one year) and 2024/2025 (recent data, Landsat 9 or Sentinel-2) - Collection: Landsat 5 for 1984, Landsat 8/9 or Sentinel-2 for 2024-2025 - Urban area detection: Use NDVI (low values indicate urban) or NDBI (Normalized Difference Built-up Index) 2. Masking strategy: - Apply cloud masking to get clean images - Focus on built-up area identification using spectral indices - NDBI = (SWIR - NIR) / (SWIR + NIR) for Landsat - Or use NDVI threshold (urban typically < 0.2) 3. Logic to distinguish Valid Zero (A/B) from Null/Error (C3): - Valid Zero: Urban area calculated as 0 km² (unlikely but valid) - C1: No images found for date ranges - C2: Images exist but no valid pixels after cloud masking - C3: Calculation returns None/NaN or unreasonable values - A/B: Compare urban areas - if 2025 > 1984, answer A; otherwise B ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Define geometry for Mekele, Ethiopia const mekele = ee.Geometry.Point([39.4753, 13.4967]).buffer(15000); // 15km radius // 2. Function to mask clouds for Landsat function maskL5(image) { const qa = image.select('QA_PIXEL'); const mask = qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 3).eq(0).and(qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 4).eq(0)); return image.updateMask(mask); } function maskL89(image) { const qa = image.select('QA_PIXEL'); const mask = qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 3).eq(0).and(qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 4).eq(0)); return image.updateMask(mask); } // 3. Get 1984 data (Landsat 5) let col1984 = ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LT05/C02/T1_L2') .filterBounds(mekele) .filterDate('1984-01-01', '1984-12-31') .map(maskL5); const size1984 = await col1984.size().getInfo(); console.log(`1984 Images: ${size1984}`); if (size1984 === 0) { console.log('No Landsat 5 data for 1984, trying extended period'); col1984 = ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LT05/C02/T1_L2') .filterBounds(mekele) .filterDate('1984-01-01', '1985-12-31') .map(maskL5); const size1984_ext = await col1984.size().getInfo(); if (size1984_ext === 0) { console.log('C1'); return; } } // 4. Get 2024-2025 data (Landsat 9, fallback to Landsat 8) let col2025 = ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LC09/C02/T1_L2') .filterBounds(mekele) .filterDate('2024-01-01', '2025-12-31') .map(maskL89); const size2025 = await col2025.size().getInfo(); console.log(`2024-2025 Landsat 9 Images: ${size2025}`); if (size2025 === 0) { console.log('No Landsat 9 data, trying Landsat 8'); col2025 = ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LC08/C02/T1_L2') .filterBounds(mekele) .filterDate('2023-01-01', '2025-12-31') .map(maskL89); const size2025_l8 = await col2025.size().getInfo(); if (size2025_l8 === 0) { console.log('C1'); return; } } // 5. Create composite images and calculate NDBI const img1984 = col1984.median(); const img2025 = col2025.median(); // Calculate NDBI for Landsat 5 (SWIR1=B5, NIR=B4) const ndbi1984 = img1984.normalizedDifference(['SR_B5', 'SR_B4']).rename('NDBI'); // Calculate NDBI for Landsat 8/9 (SWIR1=B6, NIR=B5) const ndbi2025 = img2025.normalizedDifference(['SR_B6', 'SR_B5']).rename('NDBI'); // 6. Threshold for urban (NDBI > 0.1 indicates built-up area) const urban1984 = ndbi1984.gt(0.1); const urban2025 = ndbi2025.gt(0.1); // 7. Calculate urban area in square meters const pixelArea = ee.Image.pixelArea(); const stats1984 = await urban1984.multiply(pixelArea).reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry: mekele, scale: 3000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).getInfo(); const count1984 = await urban1984.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: mekele, scale: 3000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).getInfo(); const stats2025 = await urban2025.multiply(pixelArea).reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry: mekele, scale: 3000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).getInfo(); const count2025 = await urban2025.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: mekele, scale: 3000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).getInfo(); const area1984 = stats1984.NDBI; const area2025 = stats2025.NDBI; const pixels1984 = count1984.NDBI; const pixels2025 = count2025.NDBI; console.log(`1984 Valid Pixels: ${pixels1984}`); console.log(`2025 Valid Pixels: ${pixels2025}`); if (pixels1984 === 0 || pixels2025 === 0) { console.log('C2'); return; } if (area1984 === null || area2025 === null || isNaN(area1984) || isNaN(area2025)) { console.log('C3'); return; } const area1984_km2 = area1984 / 1e6; const area2025_km2 = area2025 / 1e6; console.log(`1984 Urban Area: ${area1984_km2.toFixed(2)} km²`); console.log(`2025 Urban Area: ${area2025_km2.toFixed(2)} km²`); console.log(`Increase: ${(area2025_km2 - area1984_km2).toFixed(2)} km²`); if (area2025_km2 > area1984_km2) { console.log('A'); } else { console.log('B'); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
